name_zh: 卡比拉/东部叛军：矿区武装治理与资源民族主义
name_en: Kabila/Eastern Rebels: Mining Zone Warlord Governance & Resource Nationalism
description_zh: 洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉 (1939-2001) 1996-97 卢旺达/乌干达支持发动第一次刚果战争推翻蒙博图，1997 夺权；约瑟夫·卡比拉 (1971-) 2001-2019 继位，第二次刚果战争(1998-2003) 九国卷入/500 万+ 死亡，东部矿区(基武/伊图里) 武装团伙/马伊马伊/卢旺达/乌干达代理人控制钴/钽/金/锡。体现 M190 矿区武装治理——以"武装控矿+代理人战争+资源民族主义+生存经济"四位一体，在国家崩塌/矿产诅咒/代理人战争中构建武装治理秩序。
description_en: Laurent-Desire Kabila (1939-2001) Rwanda/Uganda backed 1996-97 First Congo War toppled Mobutu, seized power 1997; Joseph Kabila (1971-) succeeded 2001-2019, Second Congo War (1998-2003) nine nations/5M+ deaths, eastern mining zones (Kivu/Ituri) armed groups/Mai-Mai/Rwanda/Uganda proxies control cobalt/coltan/gold/tin. Exemplifies M190 Mining Zone Warlord Governance—quaternity of 'armed mineral control + proxy warfare + resource nationalism + survival economy' constructing armed governance order amid state collapse/mineral curse/proxy wars.
reason_zh: 卡比拉父子非单纯继承者，而是"武装夺权+矿区控制+代理人平衡"三位一体矿区军阀模式。老卡比拉以卢旺达/乌干达支持推翻蒙博图，小卡比拉在九国战争中平衡中/俄/美/南非/安哥拉/卢旺达/乌干达，东部矿区成生存经济基础。M190 区隔于 M189 大人制(蒙博图)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M168 资源诅咒缓解(智利)，核心在于"武装控矿即政权合法性+代理人战争即地缘生存+资源民族主义即经济基础"的刚果矿区治理极限范式。
reason_en: Kabilas not mere successors but 'armed seizure + mining zone control + proxy balancing' trinity mining zone warlord model. Senior Kabila toppled Mobutu with Rwanda/Uganda support, junior Kabila balanced China/Russia/US/South Africa/Angola/Rwanda/Uganda in nine-nation war, eastern mining zones as survival economic base. M190 distinct from M189 Big Man (Mobutu), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M168 Resource Curse Mitigation (Chile), core: 'armed mineral control as regime legitimacy + proxy war as geostrategic survival + resource nationalism as economic base' Congo mining zone governance extreme paradigm.
steps_zh: 武装夺权与矿区立足：1996 卢旺达/乌干达支持 AFDL 进军金夏沙/1997 推翻蒙博图，东部矿区为军费/兵源/外交筹码
九国代理人战争平衡：1998-2003 第二次刚果战争/卢旺达/乌干达/安哥拉/津巴布韦/纳米比亚/苏丹/乍得/利比亚/刚果布，卡比拉平衡中俄/南非/安哥拉
东部矿区武装治理：基武/伊图里钴/钽/金/锡/马伊马伊/FDLR/CNDP/M23 武装团伙控矿/走私/税收/保护费，矿区即政权
资源民族主义与生存经济：小卡比拉 2002 矿业法/审查合同/提高税收/本地加工/中国/西方投资博弈，矿产换生存
权力交接与遗产：2001 老卡比拉遇刺/小卡比拉继位/2006/2011 大选/2019 交权齐塞克迪/东部冲突持续/矿产诅咒未解，武装治理常态化
steps_en: Armed seizure & mining zone foothold: 1996 Rwanda/Uganda backed AFDL marched to Kinshasa/1997 toppled Mobutu, eastern mining zones as war funding/recruitment/diplomatic chips
Nine-nation proxy war balancing: 1998-2003 Second Congo War/Rwanda/Uganda/Angola/Zimbabwe/Namibia/Sudan/Chad/Libya/Congo-Brazza, Kabila balanced China/Russia/SA/Angola/Rwanda/Uganda
Eastern mining zone armed governance: Kivu/Ituri cobalt/coltan/gold/tin Mai-Mai/FDLR/CNDP/M23 armed groups control minerals/smuggling/taxation/protection fees, mining zone = regime
Resource nationalism & survival economy: Junior Kabila 2002 Mining Code/review contracts/raise taxes/local processing/China/Western investment games, minerals for survival

Power transition & legacy: 2001 senior Kabila assassinated/junior succeeds/2006/2011 elections/2019 handover to Tshisekedi/eastern conflict continues/mineral curse unresolved, armed governance normalized
expected_zh: 以"武装控矿+代理人战争+资源民族主义+生存经济"四位一体，在国家崩塌/矿产诅咒/代理人战争中构建武装治理秩序，刚果东部矿区成全球关键矿产供应链最前沿战场。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'armed mineral control + proxy warfare + resource nationalism + survival economy' constructs armed governance order amid state collapse/mineral curse/proxy wars, Congo eastern mining zones become global critical minerals supply chain frontline battlefield.
